body:
## [3.88.0] - 2026-09-23

### Features

- stack promotions by priority so lower-priority promos price what is still owed

### Bug Fixes

- retain direct-tag release baseline
- retain kiosk checkout integrity guards
- normalize kiosk voucher tender total
- block partial voucher settlement in kiosk
- clear admin draft before secondary navigation paths too
- revert pubspec.lock to the pinned-SDK-compatible resolution
- kiosk admin double-tap-counting, draft-override leak, label shrink, image crop
- remove duplicate lockfile fields breaking pub get
- prevent AppStatusFooter status-items overflow at desktop width
- restore scoped product updates

### Other Changes

- tag prepared release candidate directly
- Fix product target dropdown for Flutter 3.32
- pin Belgium frontend to merged Nayax API change
- kiosk payment buttons, color customization, keyboard/image/i18n fixes
- refund engine
- Keep customer keyboard editor visible
- Persist kiosk promotion lines
- Print standard kiosk receipts
- Restore regular POS keyboard layout
- Fix kiosk keyboard test provider import
- Restrict keyboard layout overrides to self-order
- Scope keyboard layout settings to self-order kiosk
- Enhance kiosk navigation and product loading experience
- Refactor product grid layout and update keyboard size settings
- Scale kiosk keyboard height at max width
- Keep resized kiosk keyboard within viewport
- Tune kiosk keyboard and catalog pagination
- Fix kiosk variant pricing and product paging
- Protect kiosk settings and move keyboard
- Add kiosk runtime settings and review adjustments
- Scale self-order kiosk keyboard for portrait screens
- Fix self-order kiosk checkout flow
